DJI.note: A Broadband Strategy study is reported complete, but no plan with targets is stated as drafted, consulted on or adopted.
Skills training counts people without saying they are civil servants.
Privacy and data protection laws named only as an indicator category; no law stated.

facts.fact: The World Bank's June 2025 report on the Djibouti Digital Foundations Project says 226 people (79 women) had been provided with improved digital skills under the project by 31 August 2024, while the coding academy and digital skills in curriculums had not started.

DJI.note: Internet user figure given is for people aged 15 and above only, and its values are unclear.
Private investment leveraged is a target with no amount recorded.
Project consultations are counted without naming a digital law or outside participants.
No school internet figure or compulsory curriculum stated.
